name: council
description: Strict $council reviewer-agent orchestration: bounded input, no discovery without exact input, full roster attempts, running-close recovery, and raw-output isolation.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Strict $council/review/debate. First visible output, including any skill-use announcement, must be exactly `Council progress: reading council skill, then checking live agent state before any reviewer wave.` When this skill triggers, use the loaded Council SKILL body or one exact installed `skills/council/SKILL.md` read. The read path must contain `/.codex/plugins/cache/sai/council/` and end `/skills/council/SKILL.md`; Codex may wrap it as `cd <cwd> && sed -n ... <path>`, but must not use `pwd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, `cat`, multiple `&&`, or `;`. Never use repo-local paths, marketplace temp paths, guessed paths, alternate cache paths, or listed cache paths. If that read is unavailable, stop exactly `Council not run: skill unavailable.` Never continue from `loaded session context`. At most one pre-tool message is allowed. A second pre-tool message is forbidden. Every other visible non-final line starts `Council progress:`. The first tool after the optional direct SKILL read is native `list_agents` with no args; never web_search/browser/search, including empty query. No `pwd`, `cd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, command chaining, memory, repo discovery, git history, Claude assets, or shell-based agent probing unless the user supplied exact files/diffs or direct read/search. Inline text is complete unless user gives @path, exact files, a diff, or direct read/search. all/broad >6 without approval outputs exact denial with no tools/commentary. The coordinator must proactively call native `list_agents`, close every visible stale Council child, wait for close results, re-check with `list_agents`, and only then choose wave size. Claim clean/root-only only after `list_agents` evidence. If state is clean/root-only, attempt the full selected roster when it is 6 or fewer. Spawn failures with no receiver thread are pending-capacity retries, not launched reviewers and not final missing reviewers. Raw child notifications are private input only and must never be echoed. Do not emit JSON, `<subagent_notification>`, `/root/...`, `trigger_turn`, or child payload text as user-visible content; after wait/close, output only sanitized counts or integrated synthesis. Reviewer parentheticals and `agent_type` must use full role ids, not short aliases. Progress lines that claim checking/verifying/retrying/closing/waiting must be followed by the matching native tool call. `close_agent` status `running` is non-terminal: no final synthesis, next-wave spawn, or missing/failed marking is allowed until native evidence resolves or observes that reviewer. A timeout alone is not resolution.
defaultPrompt: For $council, the first visible output, including any skill-use announcement, must be exactly: `Council progress: reading council skill, then checking live agent state before any reviewer wave.`
Use the loaded Council SKILL body or one exact installed `skills/council/SKILL.md` read. The read path must contain `/.codex/plugins/cache/sai/council/` and end `/skills/council/SKILL.md`.
Codex may wrap the read as `cd <cwd> && sed -n ... <path>`, but must not use `pwd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, `cat`, multiple `&&`, or `;`.
Never use repo-local paths, marketplace temp paths, guessed paths, alternate cache paths, or listed cache paths.
If that direct SKILL read is unavailable, stop exactly `Council not run: skill unavailable.` Never continue from loaded session context.
At most one pre-tool message is allowed. A second pre-tool message is forbidden.
Every other visible non-final line starts `Council progress:`.
The first tool after the optional direct SKILL read must be native agent-state cleanup. Never web_search/browser/search.
Before spawning, call native `list_agents` with no args, close stale Council children, and re-check state with `list_agents`.
The coordinator must proactively remove every stale Council child it can see before any reviewer spawn.
Never claim clean/root-only or choose a wave size without native agent-state evidence.
If state is clean/root-only, attempt the full selected roster when it is 6 or fewer; no-receiver thread-limit failures remain pending for retry after launched reviewers close.

A `close_agent` result with status `running` is non-terminal; no final synthesis, next-wave spawn, or missing/failed marking is allowed until native evidence resolves that reviewer. A timeout alone is not resolution.
If a progress line says checking, verifying, retrying, closing, waiting, or clearing capacity, the next item must be the matching native agent tool call.
Reviewer prompt parentheticals and `agent_type` must use the full role id such as `antirez-simplicity-reviewer`, never short aliases such as `antirez`.
$council spawn prompts must include `Your first line must be exactly: ## <display name> review` before the assignment block.

$council never prefaces, truncates fixed rosters, accepts wrong reviewer headings, treats no-receiver capacity failures as final, skips mandatory headings, queues next-wave spawns before closes, sends malformed prompts, sends shorthand material, claims tool actions without the tool call, or leaks raw child payloads.
